hooks.name: OpenAPI spec auto-sync
hooks.description: Regenerates the committed OpenAPI spec whenever an API controller, resource, form request or route file is written, so RULE #3 (documentation auto-sync) cannot silently drift.

action.command: cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null; REPO=/projects/sandbox/CMS_Core_StarterKit_2026; cd "$REPO" || exit 0; php artisan scramble:export >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "RULE #3: regenerated docs/openapi.json — review and commit the diff alongside your API change." || echo "RULE #3: scramble:export failed; run it manually to refresh docs/openapi.json."
